text:
Aisha: Anyone bringing weird controllers or retro consoles to the LAN this Friday? I dusted off an Atari Flashback and a modded Dreamcast — happy to share carts/discs.
Tom: Ooh Dreamcast 😍 I can bring my VGA box and a spare CRT if we want that authentic lag.
Rui: I have a bunch of spare ethernet cables and a small switch for any local netplay. labeled in blue tape.
Sasha: I can reserve 2 extra chairs by the window and bring snacks. Are we doing signups for match times? :popcorn:
Aisha: Nice re: chairs. For matches maybe a simple signup thread. I'll pin a Google Sheet later.
Tom: Also low-key bringing my PS Vita just in case anyone wants local co-op.
Rui: FYI if anyone needs controllers I can bring adapters (USB-C to older controller). Tested with Switch and PC.
Sasha: Can we please have at least one competitive Smash corner? :crossed_swords:
Aisha: Yes Smash corner. I'll bring a travel router for splits so boxes don't hog the wifi.
Tom: devops-bot: reminder posted to #random at 11:00 — and RSVP so we can count chairs.
devops-bot: (automated) RSVP link: https://forms.gle/lan-rsvp — please fill by Thursday 6pm.
Rui: Packing checklist (quick):
```
- Ethernet cables x6
- 5-port switch
- VGA box + CRT adapter
- Power strip(s)
- Controller adapters
```
Sasha: I'll add snacks to the sheet: chips + veggie platter + a small soda stash. Any allergies?
Aisha: No allergies here. Also bringing some spare batteries for wireless controllers.
Tom: If anyone has an old Saturn pad I'm borrowing for nostalgia rounds. :joy:
Rui: I can hunt mine down but might be a miss. If so I'll bring a surrogate with Saturn layout.
Sasha: Amazing. Should we do a mini show-and-tell slot before the main matches? 10–15 mins for demos and bragging rights.
Aisha: Love it. 7:15pm show-and-tell, 7:30pm matches start. Sound good?
Tom: Works for me. See y'all Friday. :thumbsup:
Rui: Count me in.
Sasha: Adding final note to sheet: "Bring surge protectors pls". :zap:
Aisha: Thanks! Anyone who wants help hauling gear Friday afternoon ping me and I can swing by.
Tom: I'll probably roll in with a cart.
Rui: 1801234567 - thread created by Aisha.
